item.abstract: A fundamental challenge in the science of consciousness is the lack of a universal, predictive framework for motivated behavior. item.abstract: Neural activity is widely held to organize on low-dimensional structure embedded in a high-dimensional state space. Persistent homology reads such structure directly from the pattern of pairwise correlations, without assuming in advance which variables are relevant.
